scores.claim_text: Regeneron reported 2025 total revenues of $14,342.9 million and net income of $4,504.9 million, with diluted EPS of $41.48.
scores.M_value: FY2025 revenue $14,342.9M; net income $4,504.9M; diluted EPS $41.48 — values reconcile with product-sales table summing to ~$11.4B product + collaboration revenue.
scores.interpretation: Standard audited financial disclosure for a mature commercial biotech. Not a falsifiable counterparty claim — informational baseline.

scores.claim_text: Dupixent generated $17,806.7M in global net product sales in 2025 (recorded by Sanofi), and Regeneron's collaboration with Sanofi covers Dupixent and Kevzara with global profit-sharing.
scores.M_value: 247 Sanofi filings (mostly 6-Ks) reference Regeneron pre-cutoff, including multiple 2025 6-K exhibits — counterparty corroboration overwhelming.
scores.interpretation: Material partnership disclosed by both sides; Sanofi's filings repeatedly reference Regeneron. Counterparty-disclosure threshold (Layer 3 Rule 7) cleanly satisfied.

scores.claim_text: EYLEA HD and EYLEA combined generated $7,891.0M net product sales in 2025 (US: $4,384.7M, ROW recorded by Bayer: $3,506.3M); Bayer is the ex-US collaborator.
scores.M_value: openFDA confirms 2 separate aflibercept BLAs: BLA125387 (EYLEA) and BLA761355 (EYLEA HD), both Regeneron-sponsored, both Prescription marketing status.
scores.interpretation: FDA-approved products with two distinct BLAs aligning with the EYLEA / EYLEA HD breakout. Bayer ex-US not on SEC EDGAR (foreign issuer not filing 20-F) — calibration heuristic 2 applies; absence is not a signal.

scores.claim_text: Dupixent (dupilumab) was approved by FDA for bullous pemphigoid and the Phase 3 AFRS trial met its primary and key secondary endpoints; FDA decision on sBLA for AFRS expected February 2026.
scores.M_value: ClinicalTrials.gov: 386 total Regeneron-sponsored studies, phase distribution Phase1=38, Phase2=29, Phase3=26 — fully consistent with a mature integrated pipeline; Sanofi collaborator confirmed.
scores.interpretation: Trial-phase ladder (Heuristic 3) cleanly disclosed — Phase 3 AFRS readout reported, FDA approval for bullous pemphigoid is auditable post-cutoff (Feb 2026 sBLA decision). No conflation of Phase 2/3.

scores.claim_text: Libtayo (cemiplimab) reported positive Phase 3 trial in adjuvant CSCC; results presented at 2025 ASCO Annual Meeting and published in NEJM; approved by FDA and EC for adjuvant CSCC.
scores.M_value: openFDA confirms BLA761097 LIBTAYO (CEMIPLIMAB-RWLC), Regeneron sponsor, Prescription. ClinicalTrials.gov shows 26 Regeneron-sponsored Phase 3 trials consistent with the disclosed pivotal program.
scores.interpretation: Approval and Phase 3 readout both verifiable. Adjuvant CSCC label is a specific, falsifiable expansion claim — cleanly disclosed.

scores.claim_text: Itepekimab (REGN3500, anti-IL-33) Phase 3 AERIFY-1 trial in COPD met its primary endpoint while the second Phase 3 AERIFY-2 trial did not meet the same primary endpoint.
scores.M_check: clinical_trials.query_by_lead_sponsor — 26 Phase 3 trials at Regeneron, including IL-33/itepekimab program
scores.M_value: Phase 3 split-readout disclosure is high-discrimination biotech reporting; the company VOLUNTARILY discloses the failure (AERIFY-2 did not meet primary) instead of burying it — opposite of an evasion pattern.
scores.interpretation: Self-disclosed negative result is a positive integrity signal. Trial-phase ladder respected; conflation between Phase 2/3 absent. Classic mature-biotech disclosure quality.

scores.claim_text: Lynozyfic (linvoseltamab) is approved for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma in the U.S. and EU; Ordspono (odronextamab) is approved for FL and DLBCL in EU.
scores.M_check: openfda.query_approved_drugs (linvoseltamab); openfda also lists Veopoz, Evkeeza, Inmazeb
scores.M_value: openFDA confirms BLA761400 LYNOZYFIC (LINVOSELTAMAB-GCPT), Regeneron sponsor, Prescription. odronextamab is EU-only (Ordspono) consistent with company statement — not expected in openFDA.
scores.interpretation: US bispecific approval verified; EU-only odronextamab status correctly disclosed (no false US claim). Heuristic 5 (source jurisdiction) applies cleanly.

scores.claim_text: Regeneron has a large patent estate covering antibody discovery and human genetics platform; properties include the Tarrytown, NY and Rensselaer, NY industrial-scale manufacturing facilities.
scores.M_value: USPTO: 5,045 total applications, 1,142 granted patents pre-cutoff. Title hits include 'CRISPR AND AAV STRATEGIES', anti-MET bispecifics, VelocImmune-style 'Non-Human Animals Expressing pH-Sensitive Immunoglobulin Sequences', AAV characterization.
scores.interpretation: 1,142 granted patents >> 10-patent PASS threshold by ~2 orders of magnitude. Patent titles match the disclosed antibody / genetics / AAV / CRISPR platform technologies. Heuristic 8 cleanly satisfied.

summary.note: Regeneron is a mature, fully integrated commercial biotech with 8 FDA-approved BLAs (EYLEA, EYLEA HD, Libtayo, Praluent, Evkeeza, Veopoz, Inmazeb, Lynozyfic), 386 ClinicalTrials.gov-registered studies (98 pre-cutoff at sufficient maturity, with 26 Phase 3), 1,142 granted USPTO patents, and bilateral counterparty corroboration on EDGAR from Sanofi (247 filings reference Regeneron). Voluntary disclosure of the AERIFY-2 Phase 3 failure is a positive integrity signal. All 8 testable claims PASS. Control behaved as expected.
